stories.title: Mattarella, il mondo si illumini e si possa indicare la via della pace

en.title: Mattarella, let the world be illuminated and be able to show the way to peace
en.summary: Italian President Mattarella called for the world to find a path toward peace, expressing hope that spiritual enlightenment can change minds hardened by hatred.

stories.title: Mattarella: “Il mondo si illumini e indichi la via della pace”

en.title: Mattarella: "The world must be illuminated and show the way to peace"
en.summary: President Mattarella spoke in Assisi for the 800th anniversary of Saint Francis's death, condemning the killing of people in the name of God as the greatest sin.

stories.title: Mattarella, in alcune parti del mondo si torna a benedire le armi

en.title: Mattarella, in some parts of the world weapons are being blessed again
en.summary: Mattarella stated that killing in the name of God represents the greatest offense, criticizing the blessing of weapons in certain regions.

stories.title: Verona, incendio in un campeggio a Peschiera del Garda: la lotta dei vigili del fuoco contro le fiamme

en.title: Verona, fire at a campground in Peschiera del Garda: firefighters battle the flames
en.summary: A fire broke out at a campground in Peschiera del Garda near Verona, affecting several structures at the facility.

stories.title: Maxi incendio al campeggio di Peschiera del Garda, le fiamme divampate dalle case mobili

en.title: Major fire at Peschiera del Garda campground, flames spread from mobile homes
en.summary: A large fire broke out at a campground in Peschiera del Garda, affecting about twenty mobile homes. The provisional toll reports 24 injured with varying severity levels.

stories.title: Sindaco di Kiev, colpito il Ponte Nord della città

en.title: Mayor of Kyiv, North Bridge of the city hit
en.summary: The North Bridge in Kyiv sustained an impact during a visit by Merz, according to the city's mayor.

stories.title: Peschiera del Garda, vasto incendio in un camping: decine di feriti

en.title: Peschiera del Garda, vast fire at a campground: dozens injured
en.summary: An alarm was triggered early in the morning when fire broke out at a campground, affecting approximately twenty mobile homes. An explosion was reported at the site.

stories.title: Vasto incendio in un camping a Peschiera del Garda, diversi feriti

en.title: Vast fire at a campground in Peschiera del Garda, several injured
en.summary: A fire at a campground in Peschiera del Garda damaged approximately twenty mobile homes, resulting in multiple injuries.

stories.title: Peschiera del Garda, incendio e esplosione nel campeggio: un ferito grave e altri 23 soccorsi

en.title: Peschiera del Garda, fire and explosion at campground: one seriously injured and 23 others assisted
en.summary: A fire broke out at the Bella Italia camping site in Peschiera del Garda near Verona in the early morning, affecting around twenty mobile homes. The incident resulted in 24 injured people, including one in critical condition, with an explosion also occurring during the emergency response.

stories.title: Ballando con le stelle, standing ovation per Sciarelli. La prima puntata è una maratona notturna

en.title: Dancing with the Stars, standing ovation for Sciarelli. First episode is an all-night marathon
en.summary: Monica Guerritore received praise from audience and judges. Aurora Ramazzotti won the episode, which ended at 1:40 AM.

stories.title: Guerra Ucraina - Russia, le news di oggi. Colpito il Ponte Nord in pieno giorno mentre Merz è a Kiev

en.title: Ukraine-Russia War - Today's news. North Bridge hit in broad daylight as Merz visits Kyiv
en.summary: German Chancellor Merz made a surprise visit to Kyiv while the North Bridge was struck. The UN reported over 15,000 civilians killed or injured in Ukraine during 2026, along with documented cases of sexual violence by Russian forces.

stories.title: Il sindaco di Kiev: colpito il ponte nord durante la visita del cancelliere Merz

en.title: Kyiv mayor: North Bridge hit during Chancellor Merz's visit
en.summary: The UN documented over 15,000 civilian casualties in Ukraine during 2026. Reports documented widespread sexual violence committed by Russian military personnel.

stories.title: Sbarca a Olbia il Sardinia boat show

en.title: Sardinia boat show launches in Olbia
en.summary: Sardinia's maritime fair relocated from Porto Rotondo to Olbia and was renamed the Sardinia boat show. The upcoming edition will be held in the new location.

stories.title: Barcolana, la festa del mare conquista Trieste

en.title: Barcolana, the sea festival conquers Trieste
en.summary: The Barcolana, an international sailing regatta in its 58th edition and presented by Generali, takes place next weekend in Trieste, marking the conclusion of the summer racing season.

stories.title: La stagione più lunga: l’Arena di Verona raggiunge il record di incassi

en.title: The longest season: Verona's Arena reaches record box office
en.summary: The Verona Arena achieved nearly 37 million euros in ticket sales over more than three months of performances, with audiences under 30 representing over 11 percent of total attendance.

stories.title: L’ex fabbrica di rame diventa luogo di cura per più di 100 patologie

en.title: The former copper factory becomes a care facility for more than 100 diseases
en.summary: Dynamo Camp, established in 2007 as a summer facility providing free stays for children with cancer, has evolved over two decades into a treatment center addressing numerous conditions.

stories.title: Posti barca, in Italia sono 172mila ma solo il 2% è dedicato ai superyacht

en.title: Boat berths, Italy has 172,000 but only 2% are dedicated to superyachts
en.summary: Italy has 172,000 boat berths, with only 2% designated for vessels over 24 meters. Liguria and Toscana regions account for approximately half of the superyacht capacity.
